description: This Java source file defines a package-private interface 'MongoHints' that provides methods for handling MongoDB hints, including obtaining hints for specific namespaces and creating hints from JSON strings. It includes nested classes for empty hints and namespace-specific hints, with functionality for parsing and mapping JSON configurations to MongoDB BSON hints.

classes.name: MongoHints
classes.description: An interface that provides mechanisms to obtain MongoDB hints based on namespace configurations or JSON input. Contains nested classes for specific implementations.

classes.name: MongoHints.Empty
classes.description: A singleton implementation of MongoHints that always returns no hints.

classes.name: MongoHints.ByNamespace
classes.description: An implementation of MongoHints that maps namespace strings to BSON hints, parsed from a JSON string.

methods.name: getHint
methods.description: Returns an optional BSON hint based on the provided namespaces set.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates a MongoHints instance that provides no hints.

methods.name: byNamespace
methods.description: Creates a MongoHints instance that parses hints from a JSON string mapping namespaces to hints.
